title: Why do you feel sick after leg day? 🤢
caption:
Your legs pull a huge share of your blood, your gut gets less, and when you stop suddenly blood pools in your legs. Cool down, keep breathing, and do not train on a full stomach. Has leg day ever got you? 👇

General information, not medical advice.

Why Does This Happen? #10
first_comment: Leg day has made me see my breakfast twice 😵 Who else?
